policies.text: A cargo freight provider gains Expedited Customs Authorization if its verified customs clearance time is under two hours and it maintains a surety bond of at least 1000000 dollars.
A passenger vessel operator gains authorization for Coastal Passage License issuance when it possesses a valid Maritime Safety Authority Permit.
A ground transit service obtains Metropolitan Express Clearance whenever its vehicle fleet age is under four years.

A charter firm earns classification as a Tier-One Operator whenever its active fleet count reaches 15 units or higher, or it maintains valid IOSA Certification, or its yearly consumer approval rating is 90 percent or above, or its annual flight dispatches exceed 500 dispatches.
An organization is chosen for the Corporate Travel Framework agreement provided it retains Preferred Carrier Network membership and provides a dedicated account management team.
A transport entity enters the Preferred Carrier Network if it is classified as a Tier-One Operator and holds an active ISO 9001 Quality Management System credential.
